text: raw Could not execute function in library Symptom Teamcenter syslog file shows following error message: Could not execute function <CATIAV4 register internal_services> in library <libcatiav4> Where does this CatiaV4 message come from, if only CatiaV5 is used? Hardware/Software Configuration Platform: all 0S: n/a 0S Version: n/a Product: TEAMCENTER Application: INTEGRATIONS Function: CATIA V5 Solution Catia started with V4. Therefore, some preferences remain set by default to support legacy cross dependencies to obsolete V4 integration. Please check "TC_register internal service module" and remove the CatiaV4 entry.
